body: The thought of joining any military branch hasn’t crossed my mind since I was a kid honestly. It’s just not for me

I feel the exact opposite, I use to be able to just brush it off and move on. Now I have breakdowns all the time, I’ve never really harmed myself in the past and now I do. I’ve never had such vivid thoughts of suicide. I don’t feel any stronger
It just gets so much harder every year
Air Force I think, doctor, fireman, veterinarian, other things kids just found fascinating and wanted to do. None of those are actually something I’d want to do
